+
+func TestConvertClaudeRequest_ToolChoiceNone(t *testing.T) {
+	channel := &model.Channel{
+		Type: model.ChannelTypeGoogleGemini,
+	}
+	meta := meta.NewMeta(channel, 0, "gemini-2.5-pro", model.ModelConfig{})
+	reqBody := map[string]any{
+		"model": "gemini-2.5-pro",
+		"tools": []map[string]any{
+			{"name": "get_weather", "input_schema": map[string]any{"type": "object"}},
+		},
+		"tool_choice": map[string]any{"type": "none"},
+		"messages":    []map[string]any{{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}},
+	}
+
+	data, err := json.Marshal(reqBody)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(
+		t.Context(),
+		http.MethodPost,
+		"/v1/messages",
+		bytes.NewReader(data),
+	)
+
+	result, err := gemini.ConvertClaudeRequest(meta, req)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	body, _ := io.ReadAll(result.Body)
+
+	var geminiReq relaymodel.GeminiChatRequest
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(body, &geminiReq))
+	require.NotNil(t, geminiReq.ToolConfig)
+	require.Equal(
+		t,
+		relaymodel.GeminiFunctionCallingModeNone,
+		geminiReq.ToolConfig.FunctionCallingConfig.Mode,
+	)
+}

+
+func TestConvertClaudeRequest_ToolChoice(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	tests := []struct {
+		name         string
+		toolChoice   string
+		wantChat     any
+		wantResponse any
+	}{
+		{
+			name:         "none",
+			toolChoice:   `{"type":"none"}`,
+			wantChat:     "none",
+			wantResponse: "none",
+		},
+		{
+			name:         "auto",
+			toolChoice:   `{"type":"auto"}`,
+			wantChat:     "auto",
+			wantResponse: "auto",
+		},
+		{
+			name:         "any",
+			toolChoice:   `{"type":"any"}`,
+			wantChat:     "required",
+			wantResponse: "required",
+		},
+		{
+			name:       "tool",
+			toolChoice: `{"type":"tool","name":"get_weather"}`,
+			wantChat: map[string]any{
+				"type":     "function",
+				"function": map[string]any{"name": "get_weather"},
+			},
+			wantResponse: map[string]any{"type": "function", "name": "get_weather"},
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			t.Parallel()
+
+			requestJSON := `{
+				"model": "claude",
+				"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
+				"max_tokens": 1024,
+				"tools": [{"name": "get_weather", "input_schema": {"type": "object"}}],
+				"tool_choice": ` + tt.toolChoice + `
+			}`
+			newRequest := func() *http.Request {
+				req := httptest.NewRequestWithContext(t.Context(),
+					http.MethodPost,
+					"/v1/messages",
+					bytes.NewReader([]byte(requestJSON)),
+				)
+				req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
+
+				return req
+			}
+			m := &meta.Meta{ActualModel: "gpt-5-codex"}
+
+			chatReq, err := openai.ConvertClaudeRequestModel(m, newRequest())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantChat, chatReq.ToolChoice)
+
+			result, err := openai.ConvertClaudeToResponsesRequest(m, newRequest())
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+
+			var responsesReq relaymodel.CreateResponseRequest
+			require.NoError(t, json.NewDecoder(result.Body).Decode(&responsesReq))
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.wantResponse, responsesReq.ToolChoice)
+		})
+	}
+}
